entities.summary: Riley D. Cote is a former Canadian professional ice hockey left winger and formerly an assistant coach with the Lehigh Valley Phantoms of the American Hockey League (AHL). He played four National Hockey League (NHL) seasons with the Philadelphia Flyers and was mainly known as an enforcer. He also won the 2005 Calder Cup with the Philadelphia Phantoms. He currently co-hosts the Nasty Knuckles podcast.
